To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ontology is a powerful tool to model knowledge, and that the ontology engineering process is complex.

- the use of ontologies in information systems is not new; - the term "ontology" was first used in philosophy and in Artificial Intelligence; - the term has now been used in Information Science, and is now used in Knowledge Management, in the form "ontology engineering", which is a new field of research; - ontology engineering is not a single field of research, but a collection of techniques and methodologies; - the use of ontology engineering is a way of improving the quality and efficiency of knowledge
In summary, our research is concerned with

1/ The definition of an object "ontology" and its relation with other objects of IA; 2/ The study of the engineering techniques for ontological modeling and the design of tools to support them; 3/ The application of ontologies in the domain of knowledge management; 4/ The evaluation of the impact of ontological modeling and of the tools to support it.

the design and use of ontologies for knowledge management.
